activeDraft.emailSubject: Application for Senior Frontend Developer - Alex Mercer
activeDraft.emailBody:
Dear Nexus AI Team,

I am excited to apply for the Senior Frontend Developer role. With my background in React, TypeScript, and dynamic dashboard applications, I am confident I can contribute immediately to your intelligent platform.
activeDraft.coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team at Nexus AI Labs,

I am thrilled to submit my application for the Senior Frontend Engineer role. With over 5 years of experience architecting React & TypeScript frontends, I have successfully built accessible, responsive interfaces that serve thousands of users daily.

My background in Tailwind CSS and state management aligns closely with Nexus AI Labs' push toward modern web experiences. I look forward to contributing to your AI candidate matching platform.

Best regards,
Alex Mercer
